about: ARX X5 at full opening: mujoco_menagerie f3b6013, arx_l5/arx_l5.xml (BSD-3-Clause): joint7 slide 0..0.044 m, q 44 mm.  The body is link6.obj, the whole hand (the housing, the gripper motor, the rails and the end stops; the jaws' racks run inside its rails and the HandUMI tips replace link7 and link8).  link6 is placed by the Library mesh, the HandUMI LEFT tip (handumi-hw 1448278), registered on link7 (iterative closest point, the rotation snapped to the axes; median 0.55 mm).  The other finger is the HandUMI RIGHT tip, the LEFT one's mirror image (z -> -z of their files, median 0.014 mm), on link8: the mirror across link6's plane between the jaws, so its sensor is the mirror-image board.
